evaluations.reason: [REQ:R4] requires flow audit evidence to record the recovery decision, current fingerprint, checkedPaths, artifact paths, and next active step. The mapped implementation writes `upgrade-recovery-audit.json` with `decision`, `currentFingerprint`, `checkedPaths`, `artifactPaths`, and `nextActiveStep: "impl-gate"`, and registers that audit artifact in the repair artifact registry, preserving canonical artifact handling [EVIDENCE:R4] [FILE-MAP:R4:1] [FILE-MAP:R4:2]. Validated execution evidence covers R4 audit recording behavior with a passing spec-local test and review [TEST:R4] [TEST-REVIEW]. Full regression is explicitly deferred to final-regression, so its absence is not a failure here [REGRESSION].
evaluations.title: R4

evaluations.reason: [REQ:R6] requires repeated stale recovery to restore current upgrade evidence before impl-gate so upgrade-result.json missing does not re-block. The mapped implementation adds UpgradeEvidenceRecovery, which bypasses when no upgrade-required paths exist, reuses only current evidence with matching fingerprint/checkedPaths/target/raw-log digest, regenerates missing or stale evidence via senti upgrade, binds current authority, and writes an audit with nextActiveStep impl-gate [FILE-MAP:R6:3] [EVIDENCE:R6]. run-gate invokes this recovery before integration artifact checks, preserving the canonical path ownership before impl-gate [FILE-MAP:R6:2] [EVIDENCE:R6]. The registry includes upgrade-recovery-audit.json as a repair artifact, supporting recovery transaction continuity [FILE-MAP:R6:1] [EVIDENCE:R6]. Execution evidence validates the repeated-stale-recovery scenario: [TEST:R6] passed and [TEST-REVIEW] passed; full regression is explicitly deferred to final-regression [REGRESSION].
